meta.name: before-you-build
meta.description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你：是创始人或产品经理，想在投入开发前确认想法是否靠谱。
copy.tagline_en: Check product risks before you build
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder or PM validating a product idea before development.

howto.what: Claude 会在动手开发前先做一次紧凑的事前审查，评估需求、定位、变现、留存、信任、分发、采用等风险，并输出风险等级、关键假设、首要验证步骤和暂缓事项。
howto.when: 当你说要开始搭建落地页、MVP、SaaS 产品等新东西，或准备发布主要功能时，Claude 会触发风险审查。

say.text: 我要做一个新的落地页，先帮我做风险审查。
say.note: Claude 会按风险清单逐项检查定位、需求等。

say.text: 这个 MVP 计划没有验证过，帮我看看最大的风险是什么。
say.note: 他会给出最可能失败的假设和最小验证步骤。

say.text: 我想给现有产品加个功能，先帮我预检一下。
say.note: 他会评估该功能对用户行为的影响，而不是直接开做。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a compact pre-mortem before building: it reviews demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risks, then outputs a risk verdict, key assumption, first evidence to find, next step, and what to delay.
howto.when_en: When you are about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product or similar, or prepare a major feature, Claude runs the pre-build risk review.

say_en.text: I'm building a new landing page — please run a risk review first.
say_en.note: Claude will check positioning, demand, etc.

say_en.text: This MVP isn't validated — what's the biggest risk?
say_en.note: He will name the top assumption and the smallest validation step.

say_en.text: I'm adding a feature — run a quick pre-mortem.
say_en.note: Claude will assess behavior impact instead of just building.
